```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Function to read the JSON file and transform it into table format
process_genotype_json <- function(file_path) {
  sid <- str_extract(basename(file_path), "^[^\\.]+")
  json_data <- fromJSON(file_path)
  
  df <- json_data %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::rename("1" = V1, "2" = V2)

  df <- df %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Gene,
      values_from = c("1", "2"),
      names_glue = "{Gene}{.value}"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sample_id = sid) %>%
    relocate(sample_id, .before = everything())
  
  # Return the formatted data frame
  return(df)
}

process_genes_json <- function(file_path) {
  json_data <- fromJSON(file_path)
  sid <- str_extract(basename(file_path), "^[^\\.]+")
  
  # Convert JSON to a dataframe
  df <- json_data %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    t() %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "Gene") %>%
    dplyr::rename(reads = V1, equivalence_classes = V2, relative_abundance = V3) %>%
    mutate(sample_id = sid) %>%
    relocate(sample_id, .before = everything())
  
  # Return the formatted dataframe
  return(df)
}

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
arcas_hla_dir <- glue("{pdmbs_dir}/workflow/RNASEQ/AIRR/arcasHLA")
genotype_df <- list.files(arcas_hla_dir,
    full.names = TRUE,
    pattern = "genotype.json"
    ) %>%
    future_map_dfr(process_genotype_json)

saveRDS(genotype_df, glue("{arcasHLA_interim}/genotype_df_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))

genes_df <- list.files(arcas_hla_dir,
    full.names = TRUE,
    pattern = "genes.json"
    ) %>%
    future_map_dfr(process_genes_json)

saveRDS(genes_df, glue("{arcasHLA_interim}/genes_df_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))

```

# Examining HLA genotype consistency across samples from the same participant as a function of read depth

```{r}
genotype_meta_df_long  <- genotype_meta_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(sample_id, participant_id), names_to = "gene_chr", values_to = "HLA") %>% 
  mutate(Gene = str_sub(gene_chr, end = -2)) %>% 
  glimpse()

genes_genotypes_df_all <- genes_meta_df %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, Gene) %>% 
  left_join(genotype_meta_df_long) %>% 
  glimpse()


# Trying to determine if there is a number cutoff that should be established to remove noisey mappinbg
hla_pid_genecounts <- genotype_meta_df_long %>% 
  select(participant_id, Gene, HLA) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, Gene) %>% 
  summarise(hla_allele_count = n()) %>% 
  glimpse()

reads_per_hla_pid <- genes_genotypes_df_all %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, Gene) %>% 
  summarise(avg_reads = mean(reads), min_reads = min(reads), max_reads = max(reads)) %>% 
  glimpse()

sid_counts <- genes_genotypes_df_all %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(participant_id, sample_id) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(participant_id) %>% 
  summarise(sid_count = n()) %>% 
  glimpse()

sid_counts$sid_count %>% table()

hla_stat_summary_df <- hla_pid_genecounts %>% 
  left_join(reads_per_hla_pid) %>% 
  left_join(sid_counts) %>% 
  glimpse()
```

Collate HLA data to participant level

```{r, eval=FALSE}
genes_genotypes_df <- genes_meta_df %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, Gene) %>% 
  slice_max(order_by = reads, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  left_join(genotype_meta_df_long) %>% 
  glimpse()

genotypes_cleaned <- genes_genotypes_df %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(gene_chr)) %>% # removes HLAs that didn't make the cut into genotype table
  select(participant_id, gene_chr, HLA) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = gene_chr, values_from = HLA, values_fill = NA_character_) %>% 
  glimpse()

saveRDS(genotypes_cleaned, 
  glue("{arcasHLA_interim}/genotypes_cleaned_{Sys.Date()}.rds")
  )

```

```{r}
# gdata_dir <- glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/cdr3_qtl/cdr3_hla_genotypes")
# dir.create(gdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Define a function to trim after second colon
format_hla_allele <- function(x) {
    # Count the number of colons
    colon_count <- stringr::str_count(x, "\\:")
    #   message(colon_count)f

    if (colon_count > 1) {
        res <- strex::str_before_last(x, ":") %>% gsub("\\:|\\*", "_", .)
        return(res)
    } else {
        res <- gsub("\\:|\\*", "_", x)
        return(res)
    }
}

format_hla_allele_vec <- Vectorize(format_hla_allele)

remove_genotypes_hwe <- c()
remove_genotypes_freq <- c()
genotype_df_list_all <- list()
genotype_df_list <- list()
genotype_df_list_only_lowfreq_removed <- list()
all_freq_df <- tibble()
all_hwe_df <- tibble()
mhc_genes <- c("A", "B", "C", "DPA1", "DPB1", "DQA1", "DQB1", "DRB1")
for (gene in mhc_genes) {
    message(glue("Processing {gene}..."))
    gcopies <- paste0(gene, 1:2)

    # Extract and clean allele names
    alleles_df <- gdf %>%
        dplyr::select(participant_id, all_of(gcopies)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate_at(
            vars(contains(gcopies)),
            ~ replace_na(., "") %>% format_hla_allele_vec()
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate_at(
            vars(contains(gcopies)),
            ~ paste0("HLA_", .x)
        )

    # Get unique allele names across both columns
    allele1_values <- unique(alleles_df[[gcopies[1]]])
    allele2_values <- unique(alleles_df[[gcopies[2]]])
    all_alleles <- unique(c(allele1_values, allele2_values)) %>% 
      discard(~ . == "HLA_") # remove empty strings

    # Create empty result dataframe
    result_df <- data.frame(participant_id = alleles_df$participant_id)

    # Fill in counts for each allele
    for (allele in all_alleles) {
        result_df[[allele]] <- 0
        # Check allele1
        result_df[[allele]] <- result_df[[allele]] +
            ifelse(alleles_df[[gcopies[1]]] == allele, 1, 0)
        # Check allele2
        result_df[[allele]] <- result_df[[allele]] +
            ifelse(alleles_df[[gcopies[2]]] == allele, 1, 0)
    }

    # Add row sum
    # message("Row sum table:")
    print(table(rowSums(result_df[, -1])))
    
    allele_freqs <- result_df %>%
        dplyr::select(-c(participant_id)) %>%
        colSums()
    # need at least 5 unique donors with the genotype to be included (5*2 for both alleles)
    # maf <- 10 / nrow(result_df)
    freq <- allele_freqs / (2 * nrow(result_df))
    freq_df <- data.frame(allele = names(freq), freq = unname(freq)) %>% 
      mutate(gene = gene)
    all_freq_df <- bind_rows(all_freq_df, freq_df)
    remove_genotypes_lowfreq <- c(
        remove_genotypes_freq,
        names(freq)[freq < 0.01]
        # names(freq)[freq < maf],
    )
    remove_genotypes_highfreq <- c(
        remove_genotypes_freq,
        names(freq)[freq > 0.99]
    )

    df <- result_df %>%
        column_to_rownames(var = "participant_id") %>%
        as.matrix()

    hwe_p <- apply(df, 2, function(x) {
        x <- as.numeric(x)
        # observed data
        a0 <- length(x[x == 0])
        a1 <- length(x[x == 1])
        a2 <- length(x[x == 2])

        freq <- sum(x) / (2 * length(x))
        # expedted data
        P_a0 <- (1 - freq)^2
        P_a1 <- 2 * (1 - freq) * freq
        P_a2 <- freq^2

        chitest <- chisq.test(c(a0, a1, a2), p = c(P_a0, P_a1, P_a2)) # simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 2000
        chitest$p.value
    })

    hwe_df <- data.frame(allele = names(hwe_p), hwe_p = unname(hwe_p)) %>% 
      mutate(gene = gene)
    all_hwe_df <- bind_rows(all_hwe_df, hwe_df)

    remove_genotypes_hwe <- c(remove_genotypes_hwe, 
      names(hwe_p[hwe_p <= 1e-04])
    )
    
    genotype_df_list_all[[gene]] <- result_df %>%
        column_to_rownames(var = "participant_id") %>% 
        glimpse()
    
    genotype_df_list_only_lowfreq_removed[[gene]] <- genotype_df_list_all[[gene]] %>% 
        dplyr::select(-any_of(c(remove_genotypes_lowfreq))) %>% 
        glimpse()
    
    genotype_df_list[[gene]] <- genotype_df_list_only_lowfreq_removed[[gene]] %>% 
        dplyr::select(-any_of(c(remove_genotypes_highfreq, remove_genotypes_hwe))) %>% 
        glimpse()
      
}

message(glue(
    "\n\nFLAG: Low frequency genotypes: \n",
    "{paste(remove_genotypes_lowfreq, collapse = ', ')}"
))

message(glue(
    "\n\nFLAG: High frequency genotypes: \n",
    "{paste(remove_genotypes_highfreq, collapse = ', ')}"
))

message(glue(
    "\n\nFLAG: Hardy-Weinberg Non-independence:\n",
    " {paste(remove_genotypes_hwe, collapse = ', ')}"
))


```

Performing PCA on genotype data

```{r}
#PCA
pca_mhc1 <- prcomp(as.matrix(mhc1_genotypes), scale = TRUE)
pca_mhc1_df <- pca_mhc1$x %>% as.data.frame()
pca_mhc2 <- prcomp(as.matrix(mhc2_genotypes), scale = TRUE)
pca_mhc2_df <- pca_mhc2$x %>% as.data.frame()
pca_mhc_all <- prcomp(as.matrix(all_mhc_genotypes), scale = TRUE)
pca_mhc_all_df <- pca_mhc_all$x %>% as.data.frame()

collect_cumvar <- function(pca_obj, df_tag) {
  data.frame("cumprop" = summary(pca_obj)$importance["Cumulative Proportion", ]) %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "PC") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(PC_num = PC %>% gsub("PC", "", .) %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(MHC = df_tag)
}

mhc1_cumvar <- collect_cumvar(pca_mhc1, "MHCI")
mhc2_cumvar <- collect_cumvar(pca_mhc2, "MHCII")
mhc_all_cumvar <- collect_cumvar(pca_mhc_all, "MHC_all")

# how many PCs are needed to explain at least 80% of the variance?
list(mhc1_cumvar, mhc2_cumvar, mhc_all_cumvar) %>% purrr::map(
  ~ {{filter(., cumprop >= 0.8) %>% slice_min(PC_num) %>% pull(PC)}}
)

p_mhc_cumulative_variance <- bind_rows(mhc1_cumvar,mhc2_cumvar, mhc_all_cumvar) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = PC_num, y = cumprop, color = MHC)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = MHC), size = 1.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_d3() +
  labs(x = "Principal Component Dimension", y = "Cumulative Proportion of Variance")

ggsave(
  glue("{hla_plots_dir}/PCA/mhc_pca_cumulative_variance.png"),
  plot = p_mhc_cumulative_variance,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)

# Saving filtered Genotype data
saveRDS(all_mhc_genotypes, 
  glue("{hla_dir}/MHC_all_cleaned_{Sys.Date()}.rds")
)
saveRDS(mhc1_genotypes,

)
saveRDS(mhc2_genotypes, 
  glue("{hla_dir}/MHCII_cleaned_{Sys.Date()}.rds")
)

# Save MHC PCA metadata
saveRDS(pca_mhc1, glue("{pca_dir}/pca_MHCI_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))
saveRDS(pca_mhc2, glue("{pca_dir}/pca_MHCII_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))
saveRDS(pca_mhc_all, glue("{pca_dir}/pca_MHC_all_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))

pca_mhc1_final_df <- pca_mhc1_df %>% 
  dplyr::rename_all(~paste0("MHC_I_", .))
pca_mhc2_final_df <- pca_mhc2_df %>%

pca_mhc_all_final_df <- pca_mhc_all_df %>%

pca_mhc_combined_final_df <- bind_cols(
```

![Cumulative Explained Variance by MHC Class](../figures/AIRR/arcasHLA/PCA/mhc_pca_cumulative_variance.png)

**Key Takeaway**

- MHC I and II have similar cumulative explained variance with 80% variance explained by 30 and 24 components, respectively.

- The combined binary matrix requires 50 PCs to explain 80% of the variance. 

- Each of the first few PCs explain only a small portion of the variance. (3-5%)

```{r}
# pid_meta <- full_meta_df %>%

#     distinct() %>%
#     glimpse()

plot_mhc_pca <- function(pca_obj, colorvar, pca_dim1, pca_dim2) {
    pca_df <- pca_obj$x %>% as.data.frame()
    var_explained <- pca_obj$sdev^2 / sum(pca_obj$sdev^2)
    percent_var <- round(100 * var_explained, 1)

    pca_df %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "participant_id") %>%
        left_join(pid_meta, by = "participant_id") %>%
        drop_na({{ colorvar }}) %>%
        dplyr::slice_sample(prop = 1) %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = {{ pca_dim1 }}, y = {{ pca_dim2 }}, color = .data[[colorvar]])) +
        stat_ellipse(type = "norm", level = 0.95) +
        geom_point() +
        scale_color_d3() +
        coord_fixed() +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(
            x = paste0("PC1 (", percent_var[1], "%)"),
            y = paste0("PC2 (", percent_var[2], "%)")
        )
}

pca_obj_list <- list(pca_mhc1, pca_mhc2, pca_mhc_all)

for (i in seq_along(pca_obj_list)) {
  pca_obj <- pca_obj_list[[i]]
  pca_obj_name <- names(pca_obj_list)[i]

  for (var in c("ethnicity", "race", "study", "case_control_other_latest")) {
    message(glue("Plotting {pca_obj_name} pca_{var}..."))

    ggsave(glue("{hla_plots_dir}/PCA/{pca_obj_name}_pca_{var}.png"), 
      plot = p, width = 10, height = 10)
  }
}
```

# Building an HLA-risk score 

Here we will use the beta-coefficients from 
(Yu E et al., 2021 | Fine mapping of the HLA locus in Parkinson’s disease in Europeans)[https://www.nature.com/articles/s41531-021-00231-5]


- This is a European-only fine-mapping in 13,770 clinically diagnosed cases, 20,214 proxy-cases, and 490,861 controls from UK Biobank and 23andMe

- Exactly four class-II alleles survived multiple-testing: DQA103:01, DQB103:02, DRB104:01 and DRB104:04, all showing protective odds-ratios (~0.86-0.89). 

 - In Europeans, PD risk within the HLA locus is almost entirely driven by the DRB1*04 protective motif; no additional independent class-I or class-III effects remain after accounting for it, streamlining future mechanistic and translational studies.



- We access the allele-level meta-analysis for 141 four-digit alleles in Supplementary Data 3 which lists the four that reach study-wide significance. 


Here we filter these four significant alleles, their beta-coefficients, and their odds-ratios.




```{r}
# Read in HLA fine mapping data from Yu et al. 2021
library(readxl)

# In this table the first set of results are not adjusted for any additional covariates, subsequent rounds adjust for other various components - we will use the first set of results.

hla_fine_mapping_path <- glue("{wkdir}/data/input/hla_fine_mapping/41531_2021_231_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx")
hla_fine_mapping <- read_excel(hla_fine_mapping_path, sheet = 1, skip = 3) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  # fill in empty gene names 
  tidyr::fill(gene, .direction = "down") %>%
  mutate(hla_allele = paste0(gene, "_", allele)  %>% gsub("\\-|:", "_", .), .before = 1) %>% 
  # this selects for results that are not adjusted for any additional covariates
  dplyr::select(1:11) %>% 
  drop_na(allele) %>% 
  glimpse()

sig_hla_alleles <- hla_fine_mapping %>% 
  dplyr::filter(p_value_8 < 0.05/141) %>%
  glimpse()

sig_hla_alleles %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene, allele, beta_coefficient = effect_6, p_value = p_value_8) %>% 
  DT::datatable()

```


Harmonizing scores with our genotype data


```{r}
hla_dir <- glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/airr/arcasHLA/analysis_cleaned")

# Loading biallelic HLA genotype count matrix
hla_alleles_df <- readRDS(
  glue("{hla_dir}/MHC_all_cleaned_unfiltered_2025-07-21.rds")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "participant_id") %>%
  select(participant_id, any_of(allele_weights$hla_allele)) %>% 
  glimpse()


allele_weights <- sig_hla_alleles %>% 
  transmute(hla_allele = hla_allele, beta = effect_6)  %>% 
  glimpse()
allele_weights

hla_score <- hla_alleles_df %>%
             pivot_longer(-participant_id, names_to="hla_allele", values_to="dosage") %>%
             left_join(allele_weights) %>%
             replace_na(list(beta = 0)) %>%
             mutate(part = beta * dosage) %>%
             group_by(participant_id) %>%
             dplyr::summarise(pd_hla_risk_score = sum(part)) %>% 
             mutate(pd_hla_risk_score_z  = scale(pd_hla_risk_score)[,1]) %>% 
             glimpse()


saveRDS(hla_score, glue("{hla_dir}/hla_risk_score_{Sys.Date()}.rds"))
#' quick note about these scores - we only have protective scores so the largest values will be 0 
#' the more negative - the more protective of a score overall

```
